description: Free: applies up to 100 rrset changes at once, all or none. Each item REPLACEs one rrset (name and type) with the given records, or DELETEs it. Deleting records can take a site or mail offline: change only what your user asked for. Pass the zone token (jdz_...) from the create answer, or a scoped account API key (jdk_...) made in the dashboard. Either passes through your model context and transcript: treat it like a password.

api_key.description: Instead of token: an account API key (jdk_...) whose scope covers this object (read, or write for changes).

changetype.description: REPLACE sets the whole rrset to records; DELETE removes the rrset.

name.description: Owner: '@' for the apex, a relative name (www) or an absolute one.

records.description: Record contents in zone-file form (REPLACE only), e.g. "192.0.2.10" or "10 mail.example.com.".

ttl.description: TTL in seconds (REPLACE only; see info for the range).

type.description: Record type, e.g. A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, CAA, SRV, HTTPS.

token.description: The zone token (jdz_...); or give api_key.

name: records_change
title: Change DNS records (free, token)
